ns0:svg.ns0:text: Technology Skill Renewal Pressure — Evidence Boundary
Across 902 occupation codes appearing in both releases, the global occupation–technology-pair Jaccard similarity
is 0.685 and the median occupation-level Jaccard is 0.6875. The low-similarity tail demonstrates strong
Database change combines labor-market change, taxonomy maintenance, data-collection updates, software/vendor
naming changes, and measurement revisions. Pair churn is therefore a renewal-pressure indicator, not a pure rate
